title: HFT School
desc: High-frequency market making and execution research — microstructure, latency-aware design and live-market validation.
subtitle: High-frequency market making, microstructure and execution
intro: A focused research track on high-frequency trading — market microstructure, latency-aware system design, market-making strategy, and the execution research that makes systematic trading work at the millisecond scale.

modules.title: Market Microstructure
modules.desc: Limit order books, queue dynamics, adverse selection — the underlying mechanics of every HFT strategy.

modules.title: Market Making Strategy
modules.desc: Quoting policies, inventory management and adverse-selection control.

modules.title: Execution Research
modules.desc: Order routing, child slicing, transaction-cost analysis and impact modeling.

modules.title: Latency-aware System Design
modules.desc: The engineering that turns theoretical edge into realized PnL — kernel bypass, lockless queues, low-latency networking.

modules.title: Machine Learning in HFT
modules.desc: Where ML works at high frequency, where it doesn't, and how to evaluate it honestly.

modules.title: Capstone
modules.desc: A market-making research artifact validated on live exchange data with full TCA.

outcomes: Reason quantitatively about queue position and adverse selection
Build market-making strategy with inventory and risk controls
Design latency-aware systems with realistic engineering trade-offs
Evaluate execution research with honest, leak-free methodology
audience: Quants moving into high-frequency systematic strategies

instructors.name: HFT Practitioner
instructors.bio: 10+ years in low-latency market making at a top-tier firm.

instructors.name: Execution Researcher
instructors.bio: Specialist in execution research and TCA.

faqs.q: Do I need C++ on day one?
faqs.a: No — Python is the primary research language. C++ is introduced for latency-critical components when appropriate.

faqs.q: Can CMF Team participants lead an HFT project?
faqs.a: Yes — Product Owner roles for HFT School project teams are open through the CMF Team application.
